scope: real product HTTP → PostgreSQL scoped pages → worker → WebGL

environment.measurement_notes: At startup, PostgreSQL and Playwright regression v3 runs concurrently on the separate knowledge_redesign_verify database. Background projection audit and Milvus indexing remain enabled.

gpu.memory_limit: Dedicated GPU allocation is not exposed by this browser API.

separately_measured_or_pending: The 1k/10k/50k gradients and 1m-edge case were measured by the renderer verifier, not this product run.

Real HTTP timings include query encoding, first-request and concurrency; the synthetic large corpus has no document chunks. Real uploaded-document retrieval is validated separately on the small governed corpus.
403/409, governance and projection consistency are covered by focused regressions, not inferred from the positive editor flow.
measurement_workloads: The initial fixed loads overlapped one full pytest run on knowledge_redesign_verify.

Directed regression sessions on that independent database also ran during parts of the stability and governed-edit phases. Host CPU/memory contention is included in these measurements; this is not an isolated baseline.
A separate read-only five-load report is retained in 2026-10-19-product-capacity-isolated-loads.json.
